title: Enterprise Capstone
goal: Transfer the TaskFlow engineering model to a larger business workflow such as procurement, HRIS, payroll, or inventory.
constraints: Finalized business periods/documents have explicit mutation rules.
Architecture choices are tied to measured scale and failure requirements.
steps: Write acceptance criteria and a boundary diagram before implementation.
Create a clean checkpoint/branch and inventory the existing files, routes, database objects, and configuration you are allowed to change.
Build one vertical slice that reaches an observable result end-to-end before broadening the feature.
Add the remaining required behavior incrementally. After each coherent change, run the narrowest verification and inspect the output.
Exercise at least two non-happy paths: malformed/missing input, authorization failure, network/database failure, race condition, or configuration error as applicable.
Run the full milestone quality gate and record results.
Perform a closed-reference rebuild or architecture walkthrough. Document trade-offs and one deliberate non-goal.

rubric.name: Correctness
rubric.description: Required behavior works and failure paths are deliberate.

rubric.name: Architecture
rubric.description: Responsibilities and dependency direction match the course model.

rubric.name: Evidence
rubric.description: Claims are backed by repeatable commands, requests, tests, or stored data.

rubric.name: Debugging
rubric.description: At least one failure is reproduced, isolated, fixed, and reverified.

rubric.name: Independence
rubric.description: The final feature can be explained or partly rebuilt without copying the reference.
